schema.content:
Table "characters" {
  "movie_title" TEXT [pk]
  "release_date" TEXT
  "hero" TEXT
  "villian" TEXT
  "song" TEXT
}

Table "director" {
  "name" TEXT [pk]
  "director" TEXT
}

Table "movies_total_gross" {
  "movie_title" TEXT [pk]
  "release_date" TEXT [pk]
  "genre" TEXT
  "MPAA_rating" TEXT
  "total_gross" TEXT
  "inflation_adjusted_gross" TEXT
}

Table "revenue" {
  "Year" INTEGER [pk]
  "Studio Entertainment[NI 1]" REAL
  "Disney Consumer Products[NI 2]" REAL
  "Disney Interactive[NI 3][Rev 1]" INTEGER
  "Walt Disney Parks and Resorts" REAL
  "Disney Media Networks" TEXT
  "Total" INTEGER
}

Table "voice-actors" {
  "character" TEXT [pk]
  "voice-actor" TEXT
  "movie" TEXT
}



Ref: "characters"."hero" > "voice-actors"."character"

Ref: "director"."name" > "characters"."movie_title"

Ref: "movies_total_gross"."movie_title" > "characters"."movie_title"

Ref: "voice-actors"."movie" > "characters"."movie_title"
